name: adam-choi-container-loader
description: Adam_Choi container loading simulator packaged for web and Android.

scripts.cap:add:android: node scripts/prepare-web.mjs && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:sync:android: node scripts/prepare-web.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:bundle: node scripts/prepare-web.mjs && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.android:apk:debug: node scripts/prepare-web.mjs && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
